rustc:
rustc 1.97.1 (8bab26f4f 2026-07-14)
binary: rustc
commit-hash: 8bab26f4f68e0e26f0bb7960be334d5b520ea452
commit-date: 2026-07-14
host: aarch64-apple-darwin
release: 1.97.1
LLVM version: 22.1.6
cpu_flags:
# Platform-specific build configuration

[target.aarch64-apple-darwin]
rustflags = [
    "-C", "target-cpu=apple-m1",
    "-C", "target-feature=+neon",
]

[target.x86_64-apple-darwin]
rustflags = [
    "-C", "target-cpu=native",
]

# Faster incremental builds during development
[profile.dev]
opt-level = 1

[profile.dev.package."*"]
opt-level = 2

# Alias for quick benchmark runs
[alias]
b = "bench"
t = "test"
pulldown_features: default: getopts, html; no simd feature
probe_cleanup: Reproduction source was formatted and given a targeted Clippy allowance after measurement; measured source is preserved verbatim.
